_about: Catalog Foreman reads during setup. Costs are rough numbers from one real account's first week of runs on the pay per use X API (owned read $0.001, post read $0.005, user lookup $0.010, all from the one price table in follow-audit/x_prices.py). Billed amounts came in at about 65 to 100 percent of the scripts' own estimates.

bots.name: Dispatch
bots.does: Your front desk. Ask it anything about the crew, it runs or explains the other bots, keeps the shared spend ledger and posts a short daily spend line.
bots.x_reads: none of its own (one $0.01 sign in check during setup)
bots.cost_note: $0. It reads the shared ledger and, if you allow it, the X developer console usage page in the browser.
bots.schedule_question: What time each day should Dispatch post the spend line?

bots.name: Follow Audit
bots.does: Tracks who follows you and who you follow. Flags inactive, dormant and gone accounts and who unfollowed. It never unfollows anyone, it only lists them.
bots.x_reads: your follower and following lists, recent posts of flagged accounts
bots.cost_note: Daily light check about $0.13. A full scan costs about $0.65 to $1.00 per 1,000 followers plus following (one 10,141 account scan was estimated at $10.04 and billed about $6.54). Run a full scan every month or two.
bots.schedule_question: What time each day for the light check, and how often for a full scan?

bots.name: Follow Finder
bots.does: Searches recent posts for creators in your niche and size range and hands you a short list worth following, with a Never show button.
bots.cost_note: About $0.45 per daily run, about $13.50 a month.
bots.schedule_question: What time each day should Follow Finder run?

bots.name: Shoutout Picker
bots.does: Once a week builds a list of mutuals and supporters worth a shoutout, skipping anyone you featured recently.
bots.x_reads: uses Follow Audit data plus a small refresh
bots.cost_note: About $0.21 a week, under $1 a month. Uses Follow Audit if installed, or runs its own follower scan.
bots.schedule_question: Which day and time each week?

bots.name: Reply Queue
bots.does: Pulls replies and mentions on your recent posts and sorts them into a queue of the ones worth answering. You reply yourself, it never replies.
bots.x_reads: your recent posts, replies and mentions
bots.cost_note: About $0.25 to $1.07 per run depending on how busy your posts are. Twice a day is about $15 to $64 a month. Billed cost has run near the low end.
bots.schedule_question: What times each day should Reply Queue run (for example 7:30 and 19:00)?

bots.name: Fan Finder
bots.does: Finds people who keep engaging with you but do not follow you yet, so you can say hi.
bots.x_reads: reuses Reply Queue's pull. Pulls on its own only if that pull is older than 12 hours
bots.cost_note: $0 when it reuses Reply Queue's pull. Without Reply Queue it costs about the same as one Reply Queue run.
bots.schedule_question: What time each day should Fan Finder run (after Reply Queue)?

bots.name: Rerun Picker
bots.does: Finds your older posts that did well and suggests which to post again, with a fresh angle. You decide and post yourself.
bots.cost_note: About $0.02 a week. One time backfill of your post history costs about $0.001 per post (3,200 posts is about $3.20).
bots.schedule_question: Which day and time each week?

bots.name: Analytics Log
bots.does: Saves your X analytics exports every day in a dated folder, so you keep a history X does not keep for you.
bots.x_reads: none through the API. It uses the browser on the analytics page, signed in by you
bots.cost_note: $0 in API fees. Premium and monetization panels are skipped and marked not available if your account does not have them.
